# Isaiah Chapter 11 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 16 verses]*

*Spirit-anointed ruler from Jesse; peaceful kingdom; knowledge of God fills earth; second exodus*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the young goat. This chapter spirit-anointed ruler from jesse.

*-- LOGOS*
